why: Issue #731. Downloads the still without its file name, so the browser names it from the blob URL and the frame, size and DPR the name carries are lost. The subject moved from src/game/gallery-workbench.ts to src/game/canvas-still.ts in issue #946, so that wiring can bind it without pulling the gallery pane into every ordinary page load; the id is kept so a `--only` selection written against it still resolves.
killedBy: downloadCanvasStill (issue #731) encodes the canvas as a PNG and downloads it under the given name
